tags.name: Satellite 3
tags.wheelchair:description: Step-free to Gates only (via lifts) from Departure area shops. No evidence of step-free from Gate to Aircraft on my visit May 2018. Toilets not checked.

tags.name: Stansted Airport
tags.wheelchair:description: Fully Step-free within building, lifts and ramps between levels. All Airside shopping outlets Step-free from Departure route. Toilets not checked on my visit.
